messages:
deploy-bot: release tag created `v2.14.0` from branch `main` @ commit `ab3f5c2f`. target rollout: staging -> canary -> prod. changelog (summary): bugfix: autoscaler throttling fix; perf: KV cache memory reduction; feat: optional quantization profile selector. change window: 2024-07-09 23:00-03:00 UTC (canary earlier). rollback plan: immediate rollback to `v2.13.7` if canary error-rate > 3% or latency p50 regresses > 30% vs baseline. ops note: Dedicated capacity pinning is manual — see example below.

deploy-bot: artifact: ci/7894 · dashboard: perf/7894

Celeste A: grabbing canary nodes now, will start canary in ~10m. posting canary plan: 5% traffic for 15m, monitor errors + p50/p95 + cost delta. smoke tests: /generate, /embed, /chat

Matt R: quick q — any DB migrations? thought there was a small KV layout tweak.

deploy-bot: no DB migrations required. KV layout tweak is backward-compatible; rolling rollback supported.

Nisha: please hold prod promotion until the background reindex finishes (ETA ~45m). canary is fine to run.

Ops Lead: noted. also requesting backport of autoscaler fix to `release/2.13` for hotfix. @release-manager can you track a backport PR?

Celeste A: @Nisha ack. starting canary at 1728500887.

Matt R: if canary shows latency regressions, do we immediate rollback or pause + mitigate? I prefer rollback for perf.

Ops Lead: agree immediate rollback for perf regressions; for functional flakiness pause and triage.

deploy-bot: canary started: tag=`v2.14.0` env=`canary` commit=`ab3f5c2f` build=ci/7894

Celeste A: canary smoke pass after 7m. no errors observed. p50 ~= baseline, p95 +5%.

Nisha: reindex finished ✅. hold lifted for prod.

Ops Lead: backport PR opened #2394 -> release/2.13 (autoscaler fix). assigning @Matt R for review.

Matt R: reviewing PR now.

deploy-bot: canary complete: success criteria met. scheduling prod promotion within change window at 2024-07-09T23:30:00Z UTC.

Celeste A: will kick prod rollout at scheduled time. note: tag will remain available for Dedicated customers to pin after prod unless told otherwise.

Nisha: do NOT auto-pin Dedicated pools without explicit sign-off. Ops, please confirm customer comms.

Ops Lead: we'll notify affected customers 30m before promotion. @release-manager please send the notice.

release-manager: sending notice now to Dedicated owners + #sre. template: short summary, impact, rollback window, contact.

Celeste A: starting prod promotion now.

deploy-bot: prod promotion started: tag=`v2.14.0` env=`prod` commit=`ab3f5c2f`.

Celeste A: prod rollout healthy on 12/12 hosts. post-deploy smoke green.

Matt R: integration tests pass. :thumbsup:.

Ops Lead: confirming no auto-pin. wait for PM sign-off before pinning Dedicated capacity.

deploy-bot: release complete: `v2.14.0` published. changelog: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/v2.14.0 · artifacts: artifact://ci/7894

Celeste A: thanks all. I'll file a short post-release checklist (metrics snapshot, cost delta, notes) and close the release board.

Nisha: follow-up: run a quantized-model canary next week — tracking in #eng-ml.

Ops Lead: rolling window cleared. marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:

Pin example (Dedicated fleet):
```
redwoodctl capacity pin --pool inference-prod --tag v2.14.0 --until 2024-08-09
```
